name: Amphitheatre of El Jem
description: Rising abruptly above the small Tunisian town of El Jem, this vast oval arena was built in the 3rd century, when the town was the Roman settlement of Thysdrus. It is the largest Roman amphitheatre in North Africa and could seat up to 35,000 spectators. Its tiers of arches still dominate the skyline, a striking reminder of how far Rome's reach extended.
